title: USCG Short; A rescue on New Year's Day!
description:
Helping out man’s best friend!
Coast Guard Air Station Astoria started off 2024 with the rescue of Leo, a family dog that fell from a 300-ft cliff in Ecola State Park, near Cannon Beach, Oregon.
The aircrew quickly sprang into action and flew an MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter to the scene. 
They successfully rescued the pup and reunited him with his owners.
